On water costs, they only record 2026. The 8 September 2026 minutes say the bill so far that year was $312.40, "a little under last year's pace," and that Paolo did not have last year's figure with him. The 3 November 2026 minutes say the 2026 water bill came to $486.75 in total.

Other water notes are about a second tap at the far end of the plots and shutting the water off for winter, not a 2025 payment. The only 2025 utility amount in the minutes is electricity for the shed lights: $96.20 for the whole year.
